query:
SELECT 
  DATE(saleDate) as data,
  COUNT(*) as vendas,
  SUM(finalAmount) as valor_total
FROM sales 
WHERE saleType = 'DELIVERY'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND saleDate >= '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY DATE(saleDate)
ORDER BY data DESC
LIMIT 10
